title: Improve quality in the encryption/hashing of the minimal personal data required
body: Improved quality in the encryption/hashing of the minimal personal data required to revoke users and avoid double checks.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: It seems like this issue might be solved, the hashing system is stronger than what we thought. I will close it unless @decidim/developers think this might require more work. Let me know.

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: @oriolgual the time might come to improve this i think we should use additional data but it is ok for now and this should go to the privacy EPIC and the GDPR EPIC.
